## R implementation notes
For text modeling, one option is `text2vec` plus `glmnet`: create the vocabulary and IDF on training comments only, then transform validation/test text with the frozen objects. Explicitly select the regularization setting and decision threshold on validation; do not rely on a default random cross-validation split across projects. Base R `grepl()` supports the keyword baseline. Use `sample()` for the justified bootstrap and plot precision versus recall, documenting ties and undefined precision.

# Week 5: Developer comments and technical debt — Student edition

## Goal
Compare keyword rules, TF–IDF classification, and LLM interpretation of self-admitted technical debt (SATD). Evaluate transfer to an unseen project.

## How to work through this notebook

Blank analysis cells intentionally do nothing until you implement them; a clean scaffold run is not a completed lab. Keep your traditional analysis independent of the model's suggestions, then compare on matched inputs. Record uncertainties rather than inventing results.

This edition contains no worked outputs or model-answer fixtures. Development/training outcomes needed for supervised learning are input data; evaluation answers are withheld.
